title: Acceptance check second look block
description: The machine-readable definition of docs/PIPELINE-CONTRACT.md §27 — the acceptance session's second look at one problem it reported, asked for by the live pass in the session's own thread (KIT-608). One block per problem. The block is written by a model: it can refute a problem or lower its severity, and it can never raise one, grant a pass or file anything.
$comment: DATA, NEVER AUTHORITY. A block for another plan or head, a block out of this shape, or a problem answered twice answers nothing: that problem stays not judged, is filed, and a high one still holds the plan. A severity above the one reported is read as the one reported.

schema.description: The marker. A block without it is not an answer.

plan.description: The epic the check is about, as the prompt names it.

head.description: The head the check judged, in full, as the prompt names it.

id.description: The problem's own id, from the session's result block.

refuted.description: True only when the second look shows the problem is not real.

why.description: One line, at most 300 characters. The live pass neutralizes it before any comment carries it.

severity.description: The severity after the second look: the one reported or lower.
